fixes.result: Preflight validates every destination; capture rejects visible linked directories; rollback journals successful mutations and rechecks paths before safe undo. Incomplete rollback identifies the recovery snapshot.
fixes.tests: Six snapshot regressions cover external-file preservation, preflight refusal, write/deletion failures, rollback containment, recovery round trip, and stable lock inode.
fixes.baseline: Initial five snapshot regressions failed before the fix.

fixes.result: Both readers search Git-ignored Markdown explicitly, without following links; grep fallback uses regular-file enumeration. Decision resolution rejects linked policy trees before reading their metadata.
fixes.tests: Git-backed fixtures cover content-only accepted policy, knowledge, patterns, bootstrap, supersession, grep fallback, and symlink boundaries.

fixes.result: Every SessionStart emits context; prompt and subagent duplicate suppression remains. Hook definitions and Stop behavior are unchanged.
fixes.tests: Native-shaped repeated compactions without turn_id, intervening turns, unchanged memory, bounded context, and startup/resume/clear delivery.
fixes.baseline: Three hook test methods failed before the fix; all fifteen focused methods passed afterward.

fixes.result: Both readers canonicalize MEMORY_ROOT before candidate expansion and authority lookups.
fixes.tests: Absolute, trailing-slash, relative, dot-relative, and root-symlink aliases preserve accepted authority and evidence paths; supersession is tested with ignored memory.

regressions.reader_baseline: Original five methods produced nine failing assertions/subtests; linked replacement regression failed for both readers and bootstrap before the graph correction.

verification.independent_review: Final review found no remaining actionable issue in the fixes.

limitations: Verification uses existing cached PyYAML 6.0.2 without installing packages; default Python lacks this optional bundled-helper dependency.
Repeated compaction is verified with documented native-shaped fixtures; this turn did not force a live model compaction. Prior live Stop evidence remains in its dedicated report.
Snapshots serialize cooperating writers; external noncooperating changes can prevent complete rollback, which now reports failure and the recovery snapshot.
